3. PUBLIC RELATIONS
3.1. Board Member and Cabinet Reports and Comments
Quick Summary / Abstract:
The Board and Cabinet may give brief reports and comments on events they have attended or other items of interest.
Minutes:
Board Member Fontes: Commented that he enjoyed attending SJHS graduation and appreciated having it in-person.

Board Clerk Rubio: Had the honor to attend both graduations and thank-you for making it possible. This is a great Board and thank you to the students that made it in spite of all they have been through.

Board Member Penaloza: I too attended both graduations and the joy that all the staff and students felt was great and both graduations were seamless and there was so much joy and closing a trying year in an elegant way and the fireworks were the sprinkles on the icing.

Board Vice-President Ojeda: Enjoyed both graduations and it was amazing to do that for our kids; attended the Phablab and hope our other middle schools can get that too. I also attended the SPED drive-through yesterday and it was fantastic.

Board Member Rex: It was great to attend the graduations and they made it look seamless. Loved the De Anza kinders at graduation and loved the Phablab.

Assistant Superintendent of Business Heeren commented he enjoyed the celebrations. Stopped by Monte Vista, yesterday was the first day of the move and they are very excited. Thursday is the first day of SJLA's move. You will also see on the Consent Agenda we are denying the bids for Wi-Fi, they did not meet our needs and they were cost prohibitive, we will keep reaching out.

Deputy Superintendent Smith commented on being busy recruiting. She thanked the Board for letting us do the things we have been able to accomplish this year and wanted to let them know they have moved the Years of Service to the Welcome Back Celebration. She wanted to let them know she wanted to celebrate them.

Assistant Superintendent of Ed Services Roach commented he wanted to highlight the banners for the top 40 students that are up around the city and thank-you to Brenda for making this happen. There were 140 students at the drive-through celebration for Sped yesterday - thank you to Dr. Gonzalez. Today is the first day of summer school and we are continuing the resolution through summer school.
3.2. Superintendent's Report and Comments
Quick Summary / Abstract:
The Superintendent may give a brief report and comments to the Board of Trustees.
Minutes:
Superintendent Dr. Pyle commented it was the best in-person graduation he had ever attended. Both celebrations were great and yesterday's celebration for the special needs students and having the cheerleaders was great. Other than summer school, we have our big Admin Advance this Thursday at Soboba and the timing makes sense to wrap up this year and kick off next year.
